summary: 1st place overall and Best Open-Source AI Project winner at Hacktoberfest Hack Day Toronto x HuskyHack 2026, built solo by Arash Shalchian. Your room as a searchable database: photograph your things, then ask where they are. Runs locally on open-weight models Qwen3.5, SAM 2.1, SigLIP 2 and U2-Net.
